template: Broker fee paid only by the party who hired the broker applies to this address. Source: M.G.L. c. 112, § 87DDD1/2, as amended by St. 2025, c. 9, § 43 (see St. 2025, c. 9, § 136); as of 2026-01-02. Not legal advice.
